about.title: About us
about.lead: A little glowing planet… where happy children live.

story.title: It began with one idea: every child should feel at home
paras: Noor Planet Nursery grew out of Our Children Abroad Institute in Ajman, when we saw how much Egyptian and Arab families in the UAE needed a place that cares for their little ones with the warmth of home and in their own language, while preparing them for a bilingual world.

We imagined a small glowing planet in space, full of stars, clouds and colour, where Noor — light — is the source of warmth and knowledge. On this planet children discover the world through play and experiment, in complete safety and under loving eyes.
Today we welcome children from 3 months to 4 years, and stay beside them until they move smoothly into KG at the Institute.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To be the most trusted Arabic nursery for families in Ajman and Sharjah, raising confident, curious children who love to learn.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To provide a safe, warm environment where children discover the world through play, learn in Arabic and English, and where we work in honest daily partnership with parents.

items.title: Safety first
items.text: No activity or decision comes before a child's physical and emotional safety.

items.title: Love and respect
items.text: Every child is a unique person with their own pace and feelings.

items.title: Cleanliness
items.text: Daily sanitising and healthy habits instilled from the start.

items.title: Partnership with parents

items.title: Identity and language
items.text: Proud of Arabic and our values, open to English and the world.

items.title: Joy of discovery
items.text: Curiosity fuels learning — we protect it and feed it.

philosophy.title: Learning through play
philosophy.lead: We blend a play-based approach with Montessori principles of independence and a prepared environment.

items.title: Play is a child's work
items.text: Every game is a chance to learn a word, a skill or a value, without pressure or rote.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Your child's and family's privacy is a trust. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how we protect it.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Child's details: name, date of birth, gender, health notes, allergies and daily habits
Parent's details: name, phone, email, area and emergency number
Documents required for enrolment (birth certificate, passport and visa, vaccinations, ID)

sections.title: How we use it
paras: We use data for one purpose: enrolling and caring for your child and communicating with the family. We never sell data or share it for marketing.
The forms on this website do not store your data on our servers; they prepare a message that you send yourself through WhatsApp to the nursery's official admissions number.

sections.title: Photos and videos of children
items: We do not photograph a child or publish their image on the website or social media without signed written consent from a parent
Consent can be withdrawn at any time, and published photos are removed within 7 working days
Daily photos are sent only to that child's own parents
We never show a child's full name next to a published photo

sections.title: CCTV
paras: CCTV recordings are used for safety only, kept for a limited period, and viewed only by authorised management or the authorities on request.

sections.title: Your rights
items: To see your child's data and ask for corrections
To ask for data to be deleted after enrolment ends, unless the law requires us to keep it
To withdraw photo and publishing consent at any time

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paras: We may use analytics tools (such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel) to count visits and improve the website. These tools do not collect children's data.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.lead: By using this website and submitting an application, you agree to the following terms.

sections.title: Enrolment and reserving a place
items: An application sent through the website or WhatsApp is a preliminary request, not a confirmed place
A place is confirmed once documents are complete, the contract is signed and the registration fee is paid
The places-available indicator on the website is a guide and is updated periodically

sections.title: Fees and payment
items: Prices on the website and in the calculator are estimates; the enrolment contract is what applies
Fees are paid in advance at the start of each month or term, depending on the package
Registration and uniform fees are non-refundable
Discounts cannot be combined unless stated otherwise

sections.title: Withdrawal and refunds
paras: Withdrawal must be notified in writing 30 days in advance. Fees are charged to the end of the current month and any balance is refunded under the nursery's approved policy.

sections.title: Health and safety
items: Parents must disclose any health condition or allergy their child has
The nursery may decline to receive a sick child to protect the other children
In an emergency the child is taken to the nearest medical centre and the parent is informed immediately

sections.title: Website content
paras: All text, illustrations and the Noor mascot belong to Noor Planet Nursery and may not be used without written permission.
